start: Settings, Health Connect page: 'Steps today' row, off

user_sees: 'See how many steps your phone or watch counted today, through Health Connect. Your steps stay on this phone.'
must_not: Steps read before the member taps

steps.action: Tap 'Show my steps' and allow Steps in Health Connect
user_sees: The row turns on with a Stop button
must_not: The row saying On while access is refused
Phone and watch steps for the same walk counted twice

start: Steps today On, the member walked since

steps.action: Leave the app and come back
must_not: The old count kept until a restart

start: Steps row, refused or no steps

user_sees: 'Health Connect isn't letting MettleUp read your steps yet. Tap "Open Health Connect" below and turn on "Steps".'
must_not: A count of 0 shown as if read

user_sees: 'Couldn't read your steps from Health Connect. Please try again later.'
must_not: A crash or an endless spinner

steps.action: Tap 'Stop showing steps from Health Connect'
user_sees: The row back to off with 'Show my steps'
must_not: Steps still read in the background

user_sees: The count again, no second permission ask if still allowed

start: Steps today On, member linked to a gym

user_sees: Steps shown only on this page of this phone
must_not: Steps sent to the gym, to MettleUp's server or to any AI
